mapper.select: SELECT status FROM incident WHERE id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_assignment WHERE account_id = #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND revoked_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM police_phone pp JOIN incident_assignment ia ON ia.account_id = pp.account_id AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE pp.id = #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pp.registered = TRUE AND ia.incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
